Aggregate cleaned LOBSTER messages to a regular time grid

Source: R/snapshots.R
lobster_snapshots.Rd

Turns the output of lobster_clean() into snapshots on a regular grid, by default every 5 seconds. Each snapshot is labelled by the end t of its interval (t - freq, t].

Usage

lobster_snapshots(x, freq = 5, split_edges = TRUE)

Arguments

x

Output of lobster_clean().

freq

numeric(1) Interval length in seconds.

split_edges

logical(1) TRUE (default) splits time weights at interval edges and carries the book state into empty intervals, as described above. FALSE reproduces the weighting of the Tidy Finance blog code, for comparisons only: each state's duration counts in the interval where the state starts, and empty intervals repeat the previous interval's averages.

Value

A data.table with columns ts, midquote, signed_volume, trading_volume, midpoint_volume, depth{bp}_ask, depth{bp}_bid, spread, n_messages, n_trades, halted and depth{bp}_truncated. The "lobster" attribute of x is kept.

Definitions

midquote

the midquote in force at t: the book state after the last message at or before t. During halts and after crossed states it keeps the last valid midquote.

spread, depth*

time-weighted averages over the interval. Each book state counts for the time it is in force inside the interval; the state inherited from the previous interval counts from the interval's start, and a state that lasts beyond the interval's end counts only up to it. An interval without messages therefore gets the book state in force throughout. Time in halts, outside the session and in crossed books does not count, nor does time in one-sided books for the spread (depth counts it, with 0 on the empty side); an interval without any such time is NA.

signed_volume

net buyer-initiated volume in shares, the sum of trade_sign * size over all executions. Unsigned trades (hidden trades at the midquote) add zero. NA only when the interval has no trade.

trading_volume

dollar volume of all executions (USD), including unsigned ones.

midpoint_volume

dollar volume (USD) of hidden executions exactly at the midquote, the part of trading_volume without a sign.

n_messages, n_trades

number of messages (types 1–5) and of executions (types 4 and 5) in the interval. n_messages == 0 marks intervals whose book variables are carried over.

halted

TRUE when the interval overlaps a trading halt.

depth{bp}_truncated

TRUE when depth within bp may be cut short by the number of levels in the file at some point of the interval.

Volumes use the time stamp of the message (an execution at exactly t belongs to the interval labelled t). Crosses (auctions) are never part of the snapshots; see lobster_crosses().

The grid runs from the start of the trading hours to the end of continuous trading. Time stamps are POSIXct in America/New_York.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
msgs <- lobster_clean(message_file, orderbook_file)
snaps <- lobster_snapshots(msgs, freq = 5)
} # }
